summary: Backend-only testing for the two new admin bulk-sync endpoints: GET /api/admin/products/export and POST /api/admin/products/bulk-import. Created 12 new pytest cases in test_avr_bulk_import_export.py — ALL 12 PASS. Full suite: 98/99 passing. The one failure is the SAME stale regression test flagged in iteration_7 (test_avr_backend.py::TestCart::test_cart_flow hard-codes seed prices 499+249=1247 while admins have renamed/repriced p_ashwagandha and p_tulsi_tea; current live subtotal 680) — unrelated to the new feature. Verified: (1) Both endpoints require Bearer token (401) and admin role (403 for regular user). (2) Export returns {products, categories, count} with count == len(products) and no Mongo _id leakage. (3) Happy path — 3 unique products → imported=3, skipped=0, overwritten=0, errors=[]; all 3 persisted and GET-able. (4) Dup-by-name — 1 pre-existing + 2 new, overwrite=false → imported=2, skipped_existing=1, overwritten=0; existing row NOT mutated (price preserved). (5) overwrite=true → overwritten=1, imported=0; row updated with new price & image. (6) Invalid entries without a name (missing key, empty string, null) → routed into errors[] without crashing; valid siblings still imported. Note: non-dict entries get rejected by Pydantic at the request-model layer (422), which is reasonable client-validation behavior and not a crash. (7) Image normalization — pass 10 URLs with the primary duplicated, a text dup, 2 whitespace entries and 8 unique: result capped at exactly 5, deduped, no empties, image == images[0] == declared primary. (8) Category merge — new categories appended to settings.categories.list, empty/whitespace entries filtered, pre-existing cats not duplicated. (9) Export → bulk-import round-trip with default overwrite=false → imported=0, overwritten=0, skipped_existing == exported count (fully idempotent). (10) Regression — every previously-green endpoint (products CRUD, orders, status history, upload, support/merchant/callmebot, admin categories/admins, auth) still passes.

minor.issue: Request body validates `products: List[dict]` strictly — a non-dict item (e.g. a string) causes a Pydantic 422 before the handler can route it into errors[]. Spec says 'items without a name should go into errors[] without crashing' which is honored for missing/empty/null name within dicts; non-dicts simply never reach the loop. Consider changing the type to `List[Any]` and letting the inner `isinstance(raw, dict)` check capture them into errors[] for a more forgiving UX during paste-from-another-env.

Dup detection uses `{"$or": [{"id": pid}, {"name": doc['name']}]}`. If an incoming product has no `id`, pid is auto-generated as `p_<uuid>` — effectively never matches by id — but match by name still works. Fine. However if someone pastes two entries with the same name in the SAME batch, the first is imported and the second is counted as `skipped_existing` (since it finds the just-inserted one). May surprise an admin expecting an error. Non-blocking.

`existing` lookup does not include `{"_id": 0}` projection — benign because Mongo returns _id and the code only reads existing['id']; _id is never echoed back to the client. No action required, but trivially cleaner to add the projection.
test_avr_backend.py::TestCart::test_cart_flow STILL hard-codes seed prices (1247.0) — this is a pre-existing failure also noted in iteration_7, unrelated to bulk-import/export.

action_items: (Optional) Loosen the Pydantic model to `products: List[Any]` so non-dict entries also fall into errors[] instead of 422ing the whole request — matches the forgiving intent of bulk-import.

(Optional, carry-over from iteration_7) Refactor test_avr_backend.py::TestCart::test_cart_flow to fetch live prices via GET /api/products/{id} rather than hard-coding 499/249. Currently the only failing test (98/99 → 99/99).
critical_code_review_comments: Both /admin/products/export and /admin/products/bulk-import correctly gate behind require_admin() (server.py:830, 843).
Export uses `{"_id": 0}` projection — no ObjectId leakage.

bulk-import normalises images via the SAME `_normalize_images()` helper used by POST/PUT /admin/products — guarantees consistent dedup/cap-5/primary semantics across the create/update/import surfaces.
Overwrite path updates by `{"id": existing["id"]}` — correct even when the dup match was by name and the incoming payload had no id (keeps the original id stable).
Category merge (server.py:889-895) correctly: fetches current list, appends only non-empty-after-strip and non-duplicate values, writes back. Empty-string guard present.
Each raw entry is wrapped in try/except — one bad entry cannot abort the whole batch.
`imported_at` timestamp is added — nice audit trail.

Minor: product documents inserted via bulk-import have `imported_at` set but `tagline/description` are coerced to str via str(..., ''), which turns `None` into the string 'None'. Current `raw.get('tagline', '')` returns '' only when the key is missing; if the key is present with None, `str(None)` -> 'None'. Likely harmless since export always writes strings, but worth noting.

success_rate.backend: 100% on new feature (12/12); 98.9% full suite (98/99) — same stale cart-price assertion as iteration_7, unrelated

seed_data_creation: Reused conftest.py seeded_admin/seeded_user fixtures. Each test inserts/deletes its own TEST_bulk_*-prefixed products via Mongo in try/finally blocks. The category-merge test snapshots settings.categories and restores it on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run: `set -a && . /app/frontend/.env && set +a && cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v`. New bulk-sync tests live in tests/test_avr_bulk_import_export.py (TestAuthGating, TestExport, TestBulkImport, TestExportImportRoundTrip). Known pre-existing failure in test_avr_backend.py::TestCart::test_cart_flow (stale hard-coded seed prices) — see iteration_7 context. The non-dict bulk-import entry case is intentionally omitted from the test — Pydantic rejects it with 422 before the handler runs; spec is honored for missing/empty/null name within dicts.
rca_of_issue: No new issues. The sole failing test (TestCart::test_cart_flow expecting subtotal=1247) is the same stale regression documented in iteration_7, caused by admin edits to p_ashwagandha/p_tulsi_tea surviving restarts (because the seed loop uses $setOnInsert — the intended behavior). Fix lives at the test layer, not in product code.
